child_genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.

child_genes.stealth: Expert at concealment and misdirection. Moves through shadows, masks scent by rolling in environmental debris, and can change pace and posture to mimic non-threatening shapes. Uses terrain features to break line of sight systematically. [!sneak]
child_genes.territorial: Covers huge territory through constant movement but rarely defends any single location. Territory is defined by range of movement rather than defended boundaries.

child_genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
child_genes.predator_defense: Alerts the entire group with loud distinctive calls when danger is spotted. Coordinates group defense by directing others to rally points, sacrificing personal stealth for collective safety. [!rally]
child_genes.reaction_pattern: Reacts instantly to everything with full-body responses. Jumps at sounds, chases shadows, and pivots toward any movement. Response speed is extraordinary but discrimination is poor.
child_genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
child_genes.social_style: Hot and cold with others, intensely loyal one moment and snapping the next. Relationships are volatile — deep bonds form quickly but can shatter over minor provocations.
child_genes.stealth: Moderate concealment ability but rarely uses it. Too interested in investigating surroundings to stay hidden for long. Can crouch quietly when motivated but tends to peek out and give away position.
child_genes.territorial: Covers huge territory through constant movement but rarely defends any single location. Territory is defined by range of movement rather than defended boundaries.
child_genes.movement_style: Bounces and hops everywhere with playful leaps and rolls. Movement is energetic but not frantic — there is a purposeful joy to each bound, often pausing to examine something interesting.

pb_genes.personality: Calm and wise, observes everything carefully before acting. Maintains emotional equilibrium in chaotic situations, processing information thoroughly before committing to any response.
pb_genes.predator_defense: Alerts the entire group with loud distinctive calls when danger is spotted. Coordinates group defense by directing others to rally points, sacrificing personal stealth for collective safety. [!rally]
pb_genes.reaction_pattern: Reacts instantly to everything with full-body responses. Jumps at sounds, chases shadows, and pivots toward any movement. Response speed is extraordinary but discrimination is poor.
pb_genes.sensory: Keen observational senses tuned for novelty rather than danger. Notices unusual shapes, colors, and sounds that others miss, but may fixate on interesting stimuli while ignoring approaching threats.
pb_genes.social_style: Hot and cold with others, intensely loyal one moment and snapping the next. Relationships are volatile — deep bonds form quickly but can shatter over minor provocations.
pb_genes.stealth: Moderate concealment ability but rarely uses it. Too interested in investigating surroundings to stay hidden for long. Can crouch quietly when motivated but tends to peek out and give away position.
pb_genes.territorial: Covers huge territory through constant movement but rarely defends any single location. Territory is defined by range of movement rather than defended boundaries.
pb_genes.movement_style: Bounces and hops everywhere with playful leaps and rolls. Movement is energetic but not frantic — there is a purposeful joy to each bound, often pausing to examine something interesting.

genes.predator_defense: Alerts the entire group with loud distinctive calls when danger is spotted. Coordinates group defense by directing others to rally points, sacrificing personal stealth for collective safety. [!rally]
genes.reaction_pattern: Reacts instantly to everything with full-body responses. Jumps at sounds, chases shadows, and pivots toward any movement. Response speed is extraordinary but discrimination is poor.
genes.sensory: Reacts to every stimulus but processes none deeply. Hears everything but distinguishes poorly between threat and noise. Jumps at rustling leaves the same way it jumps at approaching predators.
genes.social_style: Friendly and welcoming, approaches everyone with open enthusiasm and genuine interest. Initiates contact readily, shares discoveries, and draws others into collaborative exploration. [!mood(happy)]
genes.stealth: Expert at concealment and misdirection. Moves through shadows, masks scent by rolling in environmental debris, and can change pace and posture to mimic non-threatening shapes. Uses terrain features to break line of sight systematically. [!sneak]
genes.territorial: Defends territory through calculated intimidation displays that discourage intrusion without risking actual combat. Chooses confrontation timing and positioning to maximize deterrent effect.
genes.movement_style: Bounces and hops everywhere with playful leaps and rolls. Movement is energetic but not frantic — there is a purposeful joy to each bound, often pausing to examine something interesting.

genes.climate_survival: Adapts quickly to changing conditions by finding creative shelter solutions. Discovers new micro-habitats, improvises windbreaks from available materials, and leads others to protected areas.
